name: Anycubic Kobra X

sources.bed: Anycubic UK product page, Specifications: 'Printing Volume 260 x 260 x 260 mm' (https://uk.anycubic.com/products/kobra-x, read 2026-11-14)
sources.nozzle: same page: 'diameter standard 0.4 mm, expandable to 0.25 / 0.6 / 0.8 mm; Nozzle material: hardened steel'; max nozzle 300 C, hotbed 100 C
sources.layer: UNVERIFIED: 0.20 mm is the usual stock-profile layer height; the spec page lists none. Edit if your profile differs.
sources.support_angle: OrcaSlicer support_threshold_angle default = 30 deg (src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp). Anycubic Slicer Next is Orca-based; its own default is UNVERIFIED.
sources.support_trap_gap: Mold3D house value [R]: the gap an auto support would fill and weld; suite fixtures 0.3 mm fires, 5 mm does not. Not measured on this printer.
sources.bridge_mm: Mold3D house value [R] from the 2026-10 bench fixtures (10 mm bridge GO, 30 mm needs supports). OrcaSlicer's max_bridge_length default is 10 mm (PrintConfig.cpp). Not measured on this printer.
sources.overhang_deg: Prusa Knowledge Base, 'Modeling with 3D printing in mind': overhangs of 45 to 60 deg print cleanly depending on nozzle and settings (https://help.prusa3d.com/article/modeling-with-3d-printing-in-mind_164135). 45 is the safe end.
sources.min_wall_mm: 3 perimeters at a 0.4 mm nozzle [R]. Prusa KB (same article): walls thinner than one perimeter (~0.45 mm) are not printable. 1.2 mm is the house minimum that survives handling.
sources.first_layer_fuse_mm: Mold3D house value [R] for first-layer gaps that elephant foot welds. Fit Card on this printer 2026-11-13: 0.20 mm spinners broke free (knowledge/fit-table.md), so 0.35 is conservative here.
sources.overhang_area_mm2: Mold3D house value [R]: the suite's 10 x 10 mm roof (100 mm2) prints without supports, a 30 x 10 mm one (300 mm2) does not. Not measured on this printer.
sources.filament_slots: Mold3D: multicolour printer (up to 4 filament slots in the 3MF); lets `forge make keychain/sign` default to --colors 2. Set 1 for a single-filament setup.

notes: Measured print-in-place gaps for this printer: knowledge/fit-table.md (pip_gap 0.20, pip_vgap 0.35, Fit Card 2026-11-13). Adopt them with `forge fit set`.
